en-US.description: Free SFTP, SCP, S3 and FTP client for Windows
en-US.longDescription: WinSCP is an open source free SFTP client, FTP client, WebDAV client, S3 client and SCP client and file manager for Windows. Its main function is file transfer between a local and a remote computer. Beyond this, WinSCP offers scripting and basic file manager functionality.
en-US.name: WinSCP Beta
